title: We're at ACS Fall in Chicago, and the expo just kicked off. Find us at booth #224.
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
We're at ACS Fall in Chicago, and the expo just kicked off. Find us at booth #224.


If you are here and thinking about data-driven reaction optimization, high-throughput experimentation (HTE), and kinetic model development, you're in the right spot.


Our CEO, **Alexander Pomberger** , and CTO, **Daniel Wigh** , are here throughout the week.


We'd be glad to walk through the platform or just talk about data-driven process development.
